children: NRSInsights reported October 2026 same-store sales increased 1.9% year over year, versus 0.1% in September and a 1.1% decline in August. Units sold rose 0.7% year over year, while average prices for the top 500 items increased 2.2%.
Growth improved from 0.1% in September and a 1.1% decline in August, indicating a rebound in the tracked retail network.
Unit growth followed three consecutive monthly declines, suggesting the sales increase was not solely price-driven.
Sales growth remained below the report's price measure, indicating prices rose faster than same-store sales.
This reflects activity across the network, but no prior-period comparison was provided.

This is a monthly operating-data update from IDT subsidiary NRSInsights, showing a rebound after weaker readings in August and September. Further months of same-store and unit growth would help establish whether the improvement is sustained.
